title: TDMA guard and slot-duration requirements contradict the 2346 ms canonical minimum
description: Final correctness review: spec/09-packets-timing.md §14.8, python timing constants, Rust constants, and packets-timing.json require one 50 ms guard and a minimum 2346 ms slot for a maximum 255-byte SF10/125 kHz frame. spec/02a-coordinated-capacity.md still encodes guard default 100 ms and says max_airtime(current_SF)+100 ms; spec/02a-tdma.md presents a 60-byte typical packet plus 50 ms as a 250 ms slot and even says GPS may reduce the guard. These normative statements permit incompatible schedules and slots too short for the profile maximum. Align beacon field defaults, minimum-slot calculation, examples, and any guard-reduction language with the canonical maximum-frame rule and exact airtime vector.
acceptance_criteria: All normative TDMA documents and vectors require the same guard and maximum-frame-derived slot minimum at each configured data rate.
